title: Yoga for ALL with Jane & Jay
description: 8:30 AM – 9:45 AM · Join local instructors Jane del Piero and Jay Holt for a weekly class centered on deep breath work, gentle flow, and energizing chakral movement. Jane and Jay are the owners of local acupuncture, massage, and sound healing practice Luv Light. Donations are accepted. All bodies welcome.

title: DIY Upcycled Merch Workshop with Camp Alderwild
description: 1:00 PM – 2:30 PM · You know that feeling when your friend shows up to the function wearing the coolest, one-of-a-kind festival fit, and you ask, "Where did you get that?" Only for them to say, "I made it," or "A friend made it," or "I picked it up from a local artist at a festival." And you think... "Damn. I wish I knew how to do that." Good news: you can. In this hands-on workshop, MikeyJ shares the story of how he discovered upcycling and the creative practice that's shaped both his art and his career. Then it's your turn. Using thrifted clothing (choose from MikeyJ's curated thrift rack or bring your own), unique fabrics, and custom patches, you'll learn the fundamentals of sewing while creating a one-of-a-kind piece that's completely your own. …

title: High Camp
description: 4:00 PM – 1:00 PM · Nos reuniremos en la biblioteca a las 4 y conduciremos a la area cerca de Trout Lake (Lizard Head) y caminaremos una corta distancia hasta High Camp. Pasaremos la noche y volveremos a Telluride alrededor de las 12 o 1. Póngase en contacto con Claudia si tiene alguna pregunta o inquietud. Debes registrarte para este evento y los espacios son limitados
